subject: [PATCH v2] mm/ksm: keep soft-dirty and uffd-wp when merging a page

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with a suggestion to handle uffd-wp faults consistently.

reviews.author: Lance Yang
reviews.summary: Requested a new version with just the soft-dirty fix, leaving uffd-wp/RWP handling to him.
reviews.raw_body:
On 2026/10/21 16:55, Kiryl Shutsemau wrote:
> On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 10:21:53AM +0200, David Hildenbrand (Arm) wrote:
>>> +1. Did it ever actually work there :) Why not just skip them and
>>> call it a day :D
>>
>> I think QEMU just always sets MADV_MERGABLE and later activates uffd. So that
>> needs some care to not disable them. So let's rather try to get it fixed properly.
>>
>> Can you send out proper patches? Thanks!

Thanks David! Will take it over next week and get proper patches out :)

> 
> +1.
> 
> Lance's direction is right. Unsharing is not an access: do_wp_page()
> already skips the uffd-wp fault on FAULT_FLAG_UNSHARE, and RWP should do
> the same.

Thanks Kiryl! Will take a close look at that :)

Cheers, Lance

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Provided feedback on the patch, suggesting that unsharing is not an access and should be handled consistently.

reviews.author: Samarth Narang
reviews.summary: Agreed to send a new patch with just the soft-dirty fix, as requested by Lance.
reviews.raw_body:

Thanks!
